notes: 2026-11-07 review fail by reviewer: Fail on one money-safety gap. Must-fix: the wallet.outflow alert, the only active control for the high finding while WALLET_MFA is off by default, is silenced by any send that claims the hash. watcher.go:618 needs only s.tx_hash = w.tx_hash, and Submit (track.go:55) takes a hash for a prepared, expired or canceled send with no approve and no fresh sign-in. A stolen session prepares a tiny send or reuses an old expired one, drains the wallet through Privy, then submits the drain hash: no email. Fix: count a send as the explanation only when approved_at is set and from, token, to and amount match the transfer, or let Submit take only approved sends. Update TestMoneyLeavingAWalletWithoutASendTellsItsOwner, which submits an unapproved send today. Should-fix: per-payer Pay key uses the full IPv6 address (guards.go:83), so one /64 gets unlimited buckets and can fill MaxKeys; key IPv6 by /64. Leave (members.go:182) drops toRoll, so an Admin who leaves gives the owner no list. New passkey-only accounts can't pass D-49 for 24 h: no login email and the sign-up passkey is under NewAccountAge (privy.go:98). ApproveHold frees the wallet after 2 min even if the signed tx still waits in the mempool. Unclosed parts: capped-link reservation (link/checkout.go:75), settle cap past the deadline (email only), no notice on Privy email or passkey link, checkout quota per profile not per store and mode, example-merchant route unthrottled. DESIGN.md:1126 still says the Summary shows the short address. FullAddress is not on /kit. Canary still checks one factory (canary.go:237). Nits: doc comments now attached to the wrong item (endpoints.go:36, process.go:439, team.ts:11); api.md:1018 dropped rule; architecture.md and api.md notifications skip the two new email kinds; TransactionByHash found-and-mined still marks dropped (track.go:226). go vet on changed packages is clean.

2026-11-07 review pass by reviewer: Pass: no must-fix. The earlier must-fix is closed: Submit takes a hash only for an approved send, and the outflow check needs an approved send with the same wallet, token, recipient and amount. Every earlier should-fix is fixed in code or moved to F434/F435. go vet on changed packages is clean. Should-fix: (1) track.go:275 expires an approved send after 2 min when the watcher has not recorded its transfer yet (worker down or lagging). A signed, mined send whose answer was lost then stays expired, frees the wallet for a second send of the same money, and sends the owner a false wallet.outflow email (watcher.go:622 only accepts approved or same hash). Hold until the watcher has scanned past approved_at + ApproveHold, or let a later matching transfer explain and revive an expired approved send. (2) notify.go:135 skips wallet.outflow when login_email is empty, so passkey-only owners get no alert, while D-49 and money-safety.md say every owner is emailed. Record the gap or show it in the app. (3) use-wallet-mfa.ts asks for MFA only before a first send or export: an owner who only receives has none, and a stolen session can enroll its own first. Prompt at sign-in when WALLET_MFA is on, and say this in D-49. (4) privy.go:100 trusts first_verified_at; if Privy updateEmail keeps it, a swapped email passes D-49 at once. Count an email account only when its address equals users.login_email. Nits: approvals and permits signed by a stolen session leave no transfer to alert on (record in Q-13); in-flight sends at deploy have no approved_at and will alert once (backfill in 00100); the overflow bucket blocks every new public caller once 100k keys are held; R-142 still says per link; R-146 lacks the 16-endpoint cap; api.md:1027 and openapi Send.status expired text ignore the approve hold; R-188 says closed unpaid but canceled still counts (create.go:204); send-progress.tsx:54 comment says a replaced send takes its hash; signer_test.go:8 import sits in the stdlib group; roll-after-removal.test.tsx mostly checks copy; accept 1 wants the false positives listed, and the task record has none.

2026-11-07 review pass by reviewer: Pass: no must-fix. The hold, the outflow check, the sign-up-email rule and migrations 00100/00103 hold up. Should-fix: (1) TestAnApprovedSendStillWaitingHoldsTheWallet (send_test.go:513) never reaches waiting(): no scan moves the cursor past the hold, so the !read branch keeps the send approved; deleting waiting() fails no test. Move the chain past the hold (Wait, Mine, Scan) before re-sending the raw tx. (2) track.go:267-283 reads the transfer, then the cursor, in two statements; the watcher commits both in one transaction, so a scan landing between them expires a send whose transfer was just recorded. Read the cursor first. Nits: expired approved send explains every later matching transfer with no time bound (watcher.go:623); waiting() treats any RPC error as waiting, with no ceiling; on sponsored chains the wallet nonce may not show a relayed tx (unsure); R-211 and api.md:1014 omit the watcher-cursor condition; api.md:1114 says closed unpaid, code counts only expired; D-49/Q-13 don't say an owner who never set up MFA leaves the slot to a stolen session; privy.go:101 counts first_verified_at 0 as sign-up (unchanged risk).

2026-11-07 review fail by reviewer: Fail on one money-safety regression in the MFA work. Must-fix: privy.go:107 counts any mfa_methods entry and auth.go:167 lets approve pass on it, but Privy enrolls TOTP on the access token alone (initEnrollMfa needs no MFA or code when none is set). A stolen session of an owner without MFA enrolls its own authenticator, approves a send to itself with no emailed code, signs with its TOTP and submits: the approved send explains the transfer (watcher.go:620), so wallet.outflow never fires. Before, approve needed the code and the drain emailed the owner. Fix: bypass only for an MFA method Forwend saw confirmed with a fresh sign-in (store its verified_at at the first code-confirmed approve and require a match), or at least apply NewAccountAge to mfa_methods[].verified_at; add a test with a just-enrolled method. Should-fix: (1) React propagates the nested dialog close event, and Sheet onClose (sheet.tsx:53) has no target check, so dismissing Two-step setup opened from the send Summary (send-review.tsx:136) closes the sheet and cancels the prepared send; check event.target === ref.current. (2) 'Lost your phone? Contact support.' (settings-copy.ts:44) promises a recovery Q-13 says is unconfirmed with Privy. (3) A Cancel or close while a right code is being checked (mfa-prompt.tsx:44, Cancel stays enabled at :146) cannot stop it: Privy already has the code, verify resolves and the send is approved and signed, against R-219 'Closing the prompt approves and signs nothing'. Nits: a failed verify that is not a cancel shows nothing (use-send-approval.ts:52); Privy's 5-min MFA timeout leaves the prompt open and a later code hangs on Checking; Privy's promptMfa never settles without an access token, leaving the sheet locked; after Cancel in the export, Privy's own window shows 'Something went wrong'; turn-off copy (settings-copy.ts:48) is wrong with WALLET_MFA off and when Privy's 15-min pass is hot; money-safety.md:192 ties the bypass to the flag but the server bypasses whenever MFA exists; web/.env.example:6 and staging.md name different Privy dashboard settings; setup success unmounts TwoStepSetup while open, so focus falls to body; export with MFA (our dialog over Privy's Headless UI modal) has no live test (unsure it works).

2026-11-07 review fail by subagent: Fail on two money-safety holes in the two-step record. two-step-setup.tsx enrolls every linked passkey into Privy MFA with no tap and then records the methods, so a passkey a stolen session linked becomes trusted. use-send-approval.tsx records whatever Privy lists after a code-confirmed send, so a TOTP a stolen session enrolled becomes trusted. Either way the attacker approves with no emailed code and the approved send silences wallet.outflow. Should-fix: the record rereads Privy only on an empty answer; the handler sits inline in routes.go; a .tsx hook and non-hook logic sit in hooks/; Remove shows an error on cancel; useMfaStep has no unmount cleanup; api.md, openapi and R-219 wording drift; a sends_test name no longer matches; unused copy keys.

2026-11-07 review pass by subagent: Pass: no must-fix. The setup turns on only the passkey tapped on this device or made there, and only the setup records, behind a real fresh sign-in; a stolen session can't add a method beside the owner's, and one it adds first blocks the owner's setup, so nothing it set up gets recorded. The record reads Privy until it lists each method set up; the handler is in codes.go and the reread in reauth.Service; helpers moved to features/auth/lib. Follow-ups checked: record-failed copy, create-a-passkey-instead path (only the new ID turns on, with a test), WALLET_MFA rows in staging.md and .env.example, and the live send test waiting for Sent. After that check: PasskeyOnDevice on create-instead returns to the tap with its message (the reviewer's last should-fix), and the live export test signs in on its own, as it failed late in full runs with the shared session but passed alone. Open: the passkey tap is proven only against faked WebAuthn; the live suite runs with the MFA gate off.

proof.1: unit: every medium re-checked against the code first, all true positives; each fixed with a test: fresh_sign_in_test and sessions_test (code destination, recently linked, sign-up account counts, only the stored login email counts, code on its way), factory_test and receive-address.test (known factories), send_test (approve once, only approved sends take a hash, outflow alert not hidden by another send's hash, unreported hold until the watcher has read past it, waiting signature holds the wallet, late-signed send sends no alert, waiting not dropped, late mined sent), link_checkout_test and checkout_test (per payer, IPv6 /64, closed unpaid, checkout quota), ratelimit_test, webhooks_test (cap), signer_test (settle-waiting notice), team_test and roll-after-removal.test (toRoll), expiry_test (dust), payments.test (FullAddress), sends_test TestRecordedTwoStepStandsInForTheEmailedCodeOnASend (only two-step methods Forwend recorded behind a fresh sign-in let a send approve without the emailed code; one set up at Privy alone or set up again doesn't; a stale session can't record; the record reads Privy again until it lists each method just set up), use-wallet-mfa.test (both a passkey and an authenticator app before money moves), two-step-setup.test (only the passkey the owner taps on this device turns on, never another linked one; a wrong app code marks the boxes and asks for no passkey), send-approval test (no send records two-step methods, even one confirmed with the emailed code), mfa-step.test (the ask in place of the form's buttons, the passkey in one tap, a wrong code marked, Cancel ends the action, the ask ends when its form goes away), overlays.test (a dialog opened inside another closes alone), passkeys.test and passkeys-list.test (a new passkey named with the account email, a second one on the same device refused, the two-step passkey kept, a removed passkey dropped from the password manager), send-approval and wallet-screen tests (setup offered until both are on, two-step before approve, nothing approved when closed, export without the emailed code).
